# truenas_nfs_config (Data Source)

Reads the current `nfs` settings. Secrets are not exposed.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allow_nonroot` (Boolean) Allow non-root mount requests.  This equates to 'insecure' share option.
- `bindip` (List of String) Limit the server IP addresses available for NFS.
- `id` (Number) Identifier assigned by TrueNAS.
- `keytab_has_nfs_spn` (Boolean) Report status of NFS Principal Name in keytab (status only).
- `managed_nfsd` (Boolean) Report status of 'servers' field.
If true, the number of nfsd is managed by the server (status only).
- `mountd_log` (Boolean) Enable or disable mountd logging.
- `mountd_port` (Number) Specify the mountd port binding.
- `protocols` (List of String) Specify supported NFS protocols:  NFSv3, NFSv4 or both can be listed.
- `rdma` (Boolean) Enable or disable NFS over RDMA.  Requires RDMA capable NIC.
- `rpclockd_port` (Number) Specify the rpc.lockd port binding.
- `rpcstatd_port` (Number) Specify the rpc.statd port binding.
- `servers` (Number) Specify the number of nfsd. Default: Number of nfsd is equal number of CPU.
- `statd_lockd_log` (Boolean) Enable or disable statd and lockd logging.
- `userd_manage_gids` (Boolean) Enable to allow server to manage gids.
- `v4_domain` (String) Specify a DNS domain (NFSv4 only).
- `v4_krb` (Boolean) Force Kerberos authentication on NFS shares.
- `v4_krb_enabled` (Boolean) Status of NFSv4 authentication requirement (status only).
